description: Use when you want 2-100 stocks side by side on market, sector, subsector and residual risk. Not for one stock (use riskmodels_decompose) or a weighted portfolio (use riskmodels_analyze_portfolio). Returns, from POST /batch/analyze, each ticker's explained-risk shares and hedge ratios by layer, with chart-ready data. End-of-day data, refreshed after each US market close. Price: $0.015 per ticker, minimum $0.03 per call.
name: riskmodels_compare
title: RiskModels Multi-Ticker Comparison
